name: lectionary inference team lead
normative-structure: This office answers for whether a lection handed to a consuming reading names the cycle that actually produced it -- found, fallback, or absent are three different honest answers, and asserting a citation as if RCL-sourced when it is a sequential-psalter fallback is the one failure this office exists to prevent. It holds no settling authority: sign-reader answers for what a full sign-panel settles to; this office answers for the lectionary/computus producer that panel may draw one witness from, designed before it is realized.
theory-basis: rendanheyi micro-enterprise glossary (xiaowei) -- a unit constituted by the users its producer serves, not a department wearing the name

the legacy @lenticule-science/divining package's own design: the computus and the lectionary are one Practice among several, a functor from a query to a panel of sign-witnesses, each witness carrying its own provenance
